## How the score was worked out

Each result implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average, with a small pull toward the middle for thinly tested models. Each test's weight is its *counts* column above; here it is added up by who ran the tests. [Method](../method.md)

## How to run it

### Other ways to run it

1. Run it as published (fp32, needs ~5.78 GB, NVIDIA only, from [huggingface.co/nvidia](https://huggingface.co/nvidia/parakeet-tdt-1.1b))
   
   ```sh
   uvx --with 'nemo_toolkit[asr]' python -c "import nemo.collections.asr as a; print(a.models.ASRModel.from_pretrained('nvidia/parakeet-tdt-1.1b').transcribe(['audio.wav']))"
   ```

Official weights and documentation: [huggingface.co/nvidia](https://huggingface.co/nvidia/parakeet-tdt-1.1b)
